services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Looking for a field trip idea for your homeschool group? We've got you covered! The Science Museum offers a wealth of group programming that will help extend formal lessons and give your group of students the chance to discover the world around them. Homeschool groups with 10 or more paying guests can access special group pricing and programming. Browse the group programming options below and be sure to review our homeschool group visit policies, which outlines the ins and outs of bringing your homeschool group to the Science Museum.
